privacyPage.docTitle: Privacy note — You Are the Writer
privacyPage.title: Privacy note
privacyPage.lead: You trust us with your words and your details. Here is everything you need to know, briefly.

sections.p: The text you write and its title if you add one, your name as you’d like it published, your email address, your mobile number, the interface language and the time you sent it. To protect the site from automated spam we also keep a one-way coded fingerprint of your connection address (never the address itself), your approximate country and your browser type.

To read your contribution, to choose contributions for the second volume of “You Are the Writer”, and to contact you if yours is chosen. We never use your details for marketing, never sell them and never share them for any other purpose.
Only the chosen text and your name as you wrote it, based on the consent you gave when sending. Your email address and mobile number are never published.

sections.h: Who sees it, and where it is kept
sections.p: Only the book team at the author and the publisher. The data is held by cloud providers (Cloudflare and Supabase) whose servers may be outside your country.
We keep contributions while work on the second volume continues, then delete the contact details of those that were not chosen.
We use a single cookie to remember your language. No tracking or advertising tools.
